Failed my job immediately
Some guy hired me to transfer like 500 files from a program on his laptop to a flash drive, came yesterday to ‘train’ me (showed me what to do, gave passwords, ect). After he left I did like 20 files before going to bed. This morning I woke up early to do the work and tried to enter the password to the program, and guess what? I had written it down wrong. So my dumbass decided to keep trying to get it right, using a few different things I thought it could have been… I locked him out of the program. He is traveling so even though I texted him he probably won’t respond until later. I was supposed to be done by tomorrow afternoon. Great job me!
